properties.name: SourceArtifact
properties.description: Immutable original bytes, source URI/path, author, revision and digest; not its AI interpretation.

properties.name: RuleUnit
properties.description: Applicability conditions, action and exceptions forming a semantically sufficient rule unit.

properties.name: MapView
properties.description: A loss-declared multiresolution navigation view, not the source or a canonical-state write.

properties.name: MapBinding
properties.description: Binds one map span to one original source revision and reconstruction path.

properties.name: HyperRelation
properties.description: Identified joint relation with typed roles, context, conditions and exceptions.

properties.name: Participation
properties.description: One target, one relation, role and ordinal within its relation version.

properties.name: SemanticDisposition
properties.description: Role/context-conditioned transition disposition interpreted from versioned state; not merely scalar relevance.

properties.name: Context
properties.description: Task, target, operation and scope used to determine applicability.

properties.name: Placement
properties.description: Context-relative semantic neighbors and view coordinates for a stable UID; not sole physical location.

properties.name: ActivationPolicy
properties.description: Budgeted candidate selection and mandatory-source closure; never permission.

properties.name: ActivationEpisode
properties.description: Observed candidates, selected paths, fully hydrated sources, revision, cost and result.

properties.name: LocalPatch
properties.description: Bounded proposed placement/relation/disposition revision with expected versions and owner admission.

properties.name: Assessment
properties.description: Versioned eight-axis evidence profile; unknown stays unknown and violations cannot average away.

properties.name: Evidence
properties.description: Attributable check or observation with scope, artifact revision, method and limitations.

properties.name: 원문·출처 보존
properties.description: 원문 bytes와 source revision을 복원한다. 사용자 원문과 AI 해석을 분리한다. stale source와 출처 없는 주장을 탐지한다.

properties.name: 여러 해상도의 지도
properties.description: 요약의 원문 범위·손실·해상도를 명시한다. 선택된 규칙의 조건·예외까지 원문 전체를 읽는다. 지도 변경이 원문을 덮어쓰지 않는다.

properties.name: 역할 있는 결합
properties.description: 관계 ID와 역할·문맥·공동 조건을 보존한다. 필요한 순서와 예외를 검사한다. pairwise projection의 손실을 명시한다.

properties.name: 문맥별 활성화
properties.description: 작업·대상·행동에 맞는 required closure를 찾는다. required set을 선택 결과와 독립적으로 판정한다. 낮은 routing score로 필수 규칙을 누락하지 않는다.

properties.name: 분산 탐색과 비용
properties.description: structural degree·arity·candidate fanout·activation을 구분한다. coverage와 원문 읽기 비용·tail latency를 함께 비교한다. 공통 필수 허브와 무관한 broadcast를 구분한다.

properties.name: 국소 조정
properties.description: stable UID를 보존하며 placement·relation revision을 조정한다. expected revision·write set·owner admission·rollback을 명시한다. 원문·권위·다른 문맥의 관계를 무단 변경하지 않는다.

properties.name: 의미적 전이 성향
properties.description: disposition과 scalar selection score를 구분한다. 역할·문맥·interpreter revision을 연결한다. activation·causal credit·truth·permission을 구분한다.

properties.name: 관측 가능한 평가
properties.description: 평가 대상 revision·workload·evidence·실패를 기록한다. unknown과 N/A를 0 또는 만점으로 바꾸지 않는다. 구조 검사와 실제 성능·인과 주장을 구분한다.

properties.name: HSWM적 의미 지도
properties.description: Navigational synthesis of user direction; source interpretation is not the original.
properties.loss_declaration: Omits conversational phrasing and emphasis; scores and mechanisms are additional AI proposals.

properties.name: 지도에서 사용자 원문 복원
properties.description: Follow the bound original file, verify digest, then read complete bytes.

properties.name: 분산 탐색과 국소 활성화
properties.description: Separate degree, arity, fanout and realized activation; close mandatory dependencies before action; budget overflow triggers explicit paging/replanning.

properties.name: CHU 문맥별 위치 미세조정
properties.description: Separate source, placement and disposition revisions; stable UIDs; expected revisions; bounded read/write sets; existing owner admission and rollback.

properties.name: 합성 예시: 배포 규칙의 공동 적용

properties.name: BINDS_SOURCE

properties.name: USES_POLICY

properties.name: ILLUSTRATES

properties.name: TARGET

properties.description: Versioned local predicate contract; no live Neo4j schema registration.
